reason: V4 was not a true redraw. It remapped RGB values independently on each pixel of the existing 92 x 85 appliance rasters. The reduced palette amplified low-resolution edge ramps into jagged marks, and source tonal regions were misclassified as flat semantic colour. The oven therefore became soft and visibly stair-stepped when enlarged, while the dishwasher fascia acquired arbitrary turquoise blocks that no longer described its exact controls or construction.
requiredReplacementMethod: Author crisp source-locked linework above runtime resolution, preserve every structural and functional shape, then deterministically register the result to the exact existing canvas and behaviour contract. Review at both native scale and an explicitly labelled high-resolution inspection scale. Do not use direct low-resolution per-pixel palette remapping.
